name: Hunan Investment Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunan Investment Group Co., Ltd. specializes in the comprehensive lifecycle management of infrastructure projects across China, including the construction, operation, management, and maintenance of various roads, bridges, and toll facilities. Beyond its core infrastructure activities, the company also operates hotels, engages in real estate development, provides property management services, and oversees toll collection. Formerly operating as Changsha Zhongyi Group Co., Ltd., it rebranded to Hunan Investment Group Co., Ltd. in 2000. The company's headquarters are located in Changsha, China.
